summary: Frontend-only test of the agenda quick actions and short-event density, run at localhost:3000 with Playwright as admin and reception. I created 7 fresh TEST_QA appointments on Sat 24 Oct 2026. QUICK ACTIONS all pass. The 'Ações rápidas' section has the 3 buttons. Check-in takes one click, calls POST /checkin and creates a CheckIn row (method=manual). The badge changes to 'Sala de espera' and the 'Check-in realizado' toast appears. Check-in and Não Compareceu become disabled, Cancelar stays enabled and the WhatsApp button is disabled. Não Compareceu shows the confirm panel without a reason input; confirming calls POST /status, the badge shows 'Não compareceu' and status-actions-closed is shown. Cancelar shows the panel with a reason input (maxlength=300). 'Voltar' hides the panel and does not change the status. Confirming calls POST /status, the badge shows 'Cancelado' and the toast appears. Cancel from waiting_room works. After each action the event background color changes without a reload (invalidate works). Error path: I opened the modal, checked the appointment in via the API (201), then clicked Check-in in the UI. The destructive toast 'Não foi possível atualizar o agendamento / Check-in já realizado para este agendamento' appears. WhatsApp regression: the button opens a new tab and whatsapp-last-message is shown. DENSITY passes in both week and day views: 30min=xs (24px), 40min=compact (33px), 60min=medium (51px, meta shown, no status label), 90min=regular (77px, status label shown). The .agenda-event-name is fully inside the event box in every case, long names get an ellipsis, and the title tooltip contains time, name, room/procedure and status. Month view is all compact. yarn tsc -b and yarn build both pass.

minor.issue: The cancellation 'reason' is only put in the bus event payload (service.change_status extra.reason). It is not saved: the appointments table has no reason column and nothing is written to an audit row. The reason typed in the new UI is effectively lost. This is pre-existing backend behaviour.

integration_issues.issue: When a mutation fails (e.g. 409 'Check-in já realizado'), the agenda query is not invalidated. The modal keeps showing stale 'Agendado' with Check-in enabled even though the backend is now waiting_room, until a manual refresh. Suggest invalidating in onSettled/onError as well.

issues: Time format is inconsistent: xs events show '08:00' (HH:mm) while the others show '9:00 - 9:40' (FullCalendar timeText without a leading zero); the tooltip also uses '8:00 - 8:30'

Column headers show 'SEG. 05 … DOM. 04' (the dayHeaderFormat with day:'2-digit' applies to the month view), which is confusing. Use weekday-only headers for dayGridMonth via views={{dayGridMonth:{dayHeaderFormat:{weekday:'short'}}}}. Probably pre-existing
Success/error toasts still render under the dialog overlay (dimmed). Pre-existing, also reported in iteration_3
The cancel reason text persists after 'Voltar' and reopening (it is reset only on success or a status change). This is minor, and some may prefer it

action_items: Invalidate ['agenda','appointments'] on quick-action error as well (onSettled), so stale modal state self-corrects after 409/422
(Optional) Save the cancel reason in the backend (column or audit log) so the reason the UI collects is not lost
(Optional) Make the time format consistent between xs and other densities
(Optional) Fix the month view day header format
critical_code_review_comments: AppointmentStatusActions: ACTION_ALLOWED_FROM duplicates backend ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS. This is acceptable, but it will drift if the backend changes
The mutation onError only toasts; it should also call onChanged/invalidate to resync
The confirm button spinner shows whenever busy (it is not tied to the action). Harmless because only one action can run at a time

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (1 minor integration issue on error resync)

seed_data_creation: 7 Demo Odonto appointments on 2026-10-24 (Sala 1, Dr. Demo) with procedure_hint TEST_QA_*. Final statuses: xs30=cancelled (after check-in), compact40/medium60/regular90=scheduled, noshow=no_show, cancel=cancelled, 409=waiting_room.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use localhost:3000 with backend 127.0.0.1:8765 (manual uvicorn). Run python3 /app/tests/seed_quick_actions.py [YYYY-MM-DD] to create fresh appointments on free days; ids are written to /tmp/qa_ids.json. Browser TZ is UTC, so the 08:00-16:30Z slots are visible in the grid.
